Hi Sara / John —

Thanks again for running the initial perf pass last week. The team (Rishi + Priyom) and I reviewed the results and we have a short readout we can run through with your engineering and procurement leads.

Proposed agenda (30min):
- Quick recap of test config and workloads (5m)
- Key latency percentiles and tail behavior (10m)
- Root-cause notes and mitigation options (10m)
- Next steps / procurement handoff (5m)

Can we do a 30-minute readout on Wednesday 3/3 or Thursday 3/4? Our windows (PST):
- Wed 3/3: 9:00–11:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Thu 3/4: 10:00–12:00

Attached: latency_report_v1.pdf (summary) and acme-test-plan.csv (raw config). Rishi / Priyom — can you join as SE leads? Monica will own procurement coordination if needed.

Thanks,
Marissa
